# The Caelestinus Accord
[italic]Signed at Caelestinus Central, some months after the Long Night, by the Colonel for the Federation and the Grand Vizier for the Dynasty. Witnessed by the Overseer.[/italic]
The Accord is four articles long. Everyone in the sector can recite it. Few have read it.
## Article I: the anchors
The six pillars, every relay raised since, and Caelestinus Central belong to [textlink="the Bench" link="WGLoreJudges"], which is sworn to neither navy. No navy may hold, garrison or switch off an anchor.
## Article II: the line
When an anchor or relay is attacked, every ship of either signatory within reach answers it. Together.
## Article III: the war
The war between the Federation and the Dynasty is set aside until reality is safe. It may be taken up again only if the Colonel and the Grand Vizier both declare it, and never within reach of an anchor.
## Article IV: the Writ
Between peoples, the [textlink="Common Writ" link="WGCommonWrit"] is the law of the sector. Each navy keeps its own law aboard its own ships.
## From the record
[italic]A note in the margin of the Bench's copy, in the Overseer's hand.[/italic]
"Until reality is safe? I asked them both what that meant and when that may be. They both said the same thing: Never again."
